meta.source: Open Design — design-system-glassmorphism (https://open-design.ai/plugins/design-system-glassmorphism/), repo github.com/nexu-io/open-design, Apache-2.0

themes.name: Dark
themes.note: Added (not in source): app addendum. See the top-level "dark" object.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page backdrop behind every glass pane. Cool, pale blue so the frosted surfaces read.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default glass pane: cards, panels, dialogs. Always paired with a backdrop blur and the 'border' hairline.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Secondary glass pane: nested panels, input fields, sidebars sitting on a 'surface' pane.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on bg and surface (15:1 on bg).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: supporting copy, descriptions (8.8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: hints, captions, placeholders (4.6:1 on bg — the lightest grey allowed for text).

tokens.name: meta
tokens.usage: Meta labels and eyebrows. FLAG: 2.95:1 on bg — only at 24px+ or as decoration; for small meta text use accent-strong.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline on the edge of every glass pane — the 'light catching the glass' edge.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Inner dividers and borders of nested panes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand blue: focus rings, selected states, icons, large display accents, decorative backdrop blobs. FLAG: white text on it is 3.2:1 — use accent-strong behind text.

tokens.name: accent-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-strong (5.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of accent fills. Resolved from the source's color-mix(in oklab, accent, black 8%).

tokens.name: accent-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills. Resolved from color-mix(in oklab, accent, black 14%).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and small accent text — the DESIGN.md 'Primary'. White on it is 5.5:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success dots, icons and fills. FLAG: 2.1:1 on bg — never as text; use success-text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning dots, icons and fills. FLAG: 2.0:1 on bg — never as text; use warn-text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error borders, icons and fills (3.5:1 on bg — OK for borders/icons, not small text; use danger-text).

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Added for accessibility (not in source): success text on bg/surface, 4.6:1.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Added for accessibility (not in source): warning text on bg/surface, 4.6:1.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Added for accessibility (not in source): error messages on bg/surface, 5.2:1.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): filled primary button (--primary). Same as accent-strong in light; split so dark mode can lighten text without changing fills.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): hover of filled primary buttons.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): destructive fill (--destructive) with white text.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): solid fallback for glass panes where backdrop-filter is unsupported.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): dialog and sheet scrim.

tokens.name: blob-1
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): first radial glow in the backdrop (body::before).

tokens.name: blob-2
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): second radial glow in the backdrop (body::before).

styles.name: text-lg
styles.sample: Lead paragraph that introduces a section.
styles.usage: Lead copy under headlines, in fg-2.

styles.name: text-base
styles.sample: Body copy sits on frosted panes with generous whitespace.
styles.usage: Default body text and button labels.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Labels, secondary UI text, small buttons.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Captions, badges, eyebrows (in muted or accent-strong).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and tokens in docs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to field, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding, default stack gap; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: section-y-phone
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding on phones.

tokens.name: section-y-tablet
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: section-y-desktop
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, nested panes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels — the default glass pane.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panes, dialogs, large feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, chips, segmented controls.

tokens.name: elev-flat
tokens.usage: Panes that sit inside another pane.

tokens.name: elev-ring
tokens.usage: Hairline-only elevation (source: 0 0 0 1px var(--border)).

tokens.name: elev-raised
tokens.usage: Floating glass panes: cards, dialogs, menus. Soft blue-tinted glow, never grey.

tokens.name: elev-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Added (not in source): hover state of floating panes (event card).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus-visible on every interactive element.

blur.note: Not specified by the source; added so the glass effect is reproducible. Adjust to taste.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur on surface panes (assumption — source gives no value).

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus over busy content (assumption).

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: container-gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side gutter ≥1024px.

tokens.name: container-gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: Side gutter 640–1023px.

tokens.name: container-gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Side gutter <640px.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus transitions.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Panels opening, dialogs, larger moves.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: The one easing curve for all transitions.

dark.note: App addendum, not in the upstream source. Applied by a :root.dark block in src/styles.css (the dark class on <html>). Lists only the rows whose dark value differs from light; all other tokens are unchanged. Spec: docs/specs/glassmorphism-dark-mode.md.

tokens.name: color-scheme
tokens.usage: Makes native form controls and scrollbars dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default translucent navy glass pane, with a faint white border.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Secondary glass pane, nested inside a surface pane.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered pane and popover background.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Solid fallback for panes where backdrop-filter is unsupported.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text (15.8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (10.5:1 on bg).

tokens.name: muted

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Glass pane hairline edge.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Inner dividers of nested panes.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Small accent text and links (8.8:1 on bg). Filled buttons stay on accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-strong-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of accent text.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text (10.6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Warning text (11.0:1 on bg).

tokens.name: danger-text

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive fill with white text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet scrim.

tokens.name: blob-1
tokens.usage: First backdrop glow, about half the light alpha.

tokens.name: blob-2
tokens.usage: Second backdrop glow, about half the light alpha.

tokens.name: elev-raised
tokens.usage: Soft black shadow for floating panes, replacing the blue glow.

tokens.name: elev-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover shadow for floating panes.

tokens.name: elev-ring
tokens.usage: Hairline-only elevation.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Night mode: solid ring plus halo, 8:1 against a card (the halo alone was 2.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Night mode: deeper, less luminous cobalt for primary fills. White text 6.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Night mode: hover for the night cobalt fill.

tokens.name: surface-header
tokens.usage: Night mode: sticky header opaque enough that footage under it keeps nav text legible.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Added: boundary for inputs, selects, pills, switches and slider rails. 3.4:1 against a card.

tokens.name: control-fill
tokens.usage: Added: recessed fill for inputs, selects and switch tracks.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Added: pearl switch and slider thumbs instead of glare white.
